releaseNotes.zh: AI 点数按实际用量结算，每 1 万 token 为 1 点，记录按对话汇总。改进菜谱人数与份量处理，失败重试会根据原因纠正。无需邀请码即可按现有政策领取免费额度。覆盖安装保留本地数据，更新不会重复赠送点数。
releaseNotes.en: AI credits follow actual usage: 10,000 tokens per credit, with history grouped by conversation. Improves recipe portions and gives retries corrective context. Free credits remain available without an invitation under the existing policy. Install over the existing app to retain local data; updating does not repeat a credit grant.
